ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels covering approximately 95% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated only at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across the entire contiguous surface area of both lobes; no mottling or internal geometric blobs visible.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the center-point with a clearly defined vertex and deep indentation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, irregular serration consisting of high-frequency peaks and valleys along the entire linear boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep following the interior trailing edge, transitioning to a horizontal orientation toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white pixel clusters located at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, identifying localized barnacle colonies.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible barnacle colonization and associated scarring on the distal extremities of the fluke lobes.
